# Frontend Slides Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor: Creates animation-rich HTML presentations from scratch or by converting a PowerPoint file, with zero dependencies and no build step. It shows three visual style previews first, then builds one self-contained file on a fixed 1920 by 1080 stage.

Style discovery comes first: three visual previews, one safe preset, at least one bold template from the pack of 106, and one wildcard, then the full deck is built from the chosen direction. Conversion runs scripts/extract-pptx.py, export to PDF uses a headless browser, and an optional deploy to a free Vercel URL is offered after delivery. Slides stay on a fixed 1920 by 1080 stage that never reflows, so phones letterbox instead of rearranging content. The repo's last code push dates from June 2026. By @zarazhangrui, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via GitHub. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
